name: red-evidence-artifact-validation
title: Validate the legacy v1 red-evidence artifact before enforce-gate evaluation
description: On main @ 1847b3af6d a malformed record OR a malformed file envelope in a story's red-evidence.json crashes the LIVE dev/review/done enforce gate with a bare TypeError instead of failing closed, because store.readRedEvidence is a bare JSON.parse-and-cast with no validation between parse and the typed domain. Pre-existing, not a regression. Fix per the settled decisions in docs/requirements/decisions/red-evidence-legacy-v1-record-validation-audit.md: full v1 validation at the read boundary covering envelope and records, malformed entries quarantined rather than thrown, the gate predicate kept total as defense-in-depth, and a mandatory migration scan proving no valid verdict moved. The invariance baseline is derived on main by this story, never imported from another tree. NOTE: all line citations in this story and in the decision document were verified against main @ 1847b3af6d; main has since advanced (CLI 0.3.239 -> 0.3.242) and a few line numbers have drifted by unrelated commits (for example core/machine.ts:167 and core/types.ts:2678-2698). Semantics are unaffected - re-locate by symbol, not by line, and trust the symbol.
